passages.title: Ms. Jones Begins the Investigation
text: Mom called Ms. Jones to find the person who ate the cake.
Ms. Jones was a wise old lady who lived next door.
Everyone in town came to her when they were in trouble.
Ms. Jones came with her sweet smile.
“Don’t worry! Let’s find out the big eater!”
She asked Mom, “Who was in the house this morning?”
koreanText: 엄마는 케이크를 먹은 사람을 찾기 위해 Ms. Jones에게 전화했다.
Ms. Jones는 옆집에 사는 현명한 노부인이었다.
마을에 있는 모든 사람은 그들이 곤경에 처했을 때 그녀에게 왔다.
Ms. Jones는 다정한 미소를 지으며 왔다.
그녀는 엄마에게 물었다, “누가 오늘 아침에 집에 있었죠?”
